messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: value.name in melt
parts:
Hi Felipe:

As Hadley's note mentioned, if reshape is not already loaded, value.name will work.

In a fresh R session:

> library(reshape2)
> df <- data.frame(x = 1:2, y = 1:2)
> melt(df, value.name = 'a')

Using  as id variables
  variable a
1        x 1
2        x 2
3        y 1
4        y 2
> search()
 [1] ".GlobalEnv"        "package:reshape2"  "package:stats"   
 [4] "package:graphics"  "package:grDevices" "package:utils"   
 [7] "package:datasets"  "package:methods"   "Autoloads"       
[10] "package:base"

# ...but once you load reshape,
> library(reshape)
Loading required package: plyr

Attaching package: 'reshape'

The following object(s) are masked from 'package:plyr':

    round_any

The following object(s) are masked from 'package:reshape2':

    colsplit, melt, recast
> reshape2::melt(df, value.name = 'a')

Using  as id variables
  variable value
1        x     1
2        x     2
3        y     1
4        y     2

Even if you detach and reload reshape2 to put it ahead in the search list, it won't fix matters because of the namespace problem. But if you detach reshape while keeping reshape2 loaded, then it should work (at least it does for me on a Win7 system with 64-bit  R):

> detach(package:reshape)
> search()
 [1] ".GlobalEnv"        "package:reshape2"  "package:plyr"    
 [4] "package:stats"     "package:graphics"  "package:grDevices"
 [7] "package:utils"     "package:datasets"  "package:methods" 
[10] "Autoloads"         "package:base"
> reshape2::melt(df, value.name = 'a')

Using  as id variables
  variable a
1        x 1
2        x 2
3        y 1
4        y 2
> melt(df, value.name = 'a')

Using  as id variables
  variable a
1        x 1
2        x 2
3        y 1
4        y 2

HTH,
Dennis
